Clarification mapping

- `/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]` only confirms continuation; it adds no extra scope beyond the issue body.

Preliminary audit note / likely blocker
- Read-only inspection already suggests archival may still be blocked:
  - Goal 10 (“naming verbosity”) appears only partially present: `prompts/mode-implement.txt` has “Prefer descriptive names over abbreviations…”, but not the stricter “avoid 1–2 character names except tight scopes” rule from the plan.
  - Goal 12 (“flow rubric”) also appears lighter than planned: the file currently has a short “Preferred flow…” line, not the fuller discovery/status-update/batch/reconcile cadence described in the plan.
- Because this issue forbids edits outside the two plan-doc paths, the implementation rollout should start with the audit gate. If either gap is confirmed as truly missing (not just acceptable wording drift), the correct outcome is `BLOCKED:` with no archival edits.

Files likely to change
- `docs/completed/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` — new canonical completed-plan record, only if all 13 goals pass the re-audit.
- `docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` — replace the full body with a short archived-pointer stub, only if the archive gate passes.

Implementation steps
1. Re-audit all 13 goals from `docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` against shipped HEAD, using this mapping:
   - 1 tool-name opacity → `unattended_system_instructions.md` output contract + `CLAUDE.md` §7
   - 2 anti-laziness → `unattended_system_instructions.md` §2
   - 3 root-cause-not-symptom → `unattended_system_instructions.md` role sections
   - 4 status-update cadence → `unattended_system_instructions.md` §3
   - 5 verification order → `unattended_system_instructions.md` verification loop
   - 6 no re-read after `apply_patch` → `unattended_system_instructions.md` §4
   - 7 subagent dos/don’ts → `CLAUDE.md` §16
   - 8 surgical-vs-ambitious guidance → `unattended_system_instructions.md` §9
   - 9 plan-divergence discipline → `prompts/mode-implement*.txt`
   - 10 descriptive naming verbosity → `prompts/mode-implement.txt`
   - 11 no inline comments unless requested → `prompts/mode-implement.txt`
   - 12 flow rubric → `prompts/mode-implement.txt`
   - 13 reviewer fabrication ban → `prompts/review-reviewer-checklist.txt`
2. Decision gate:
   - If any goal is missing or only partially satisfied in a load-bearing way, stop and return `BLOCKED:` listing each missing goal explicitly. Make no file edits.
   - Treat minor wording drift as acceptable only if the full behavioral constraint is still present.
3. If all 13 goals pass, create `docs/completed/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` using the existing plan title plus:
   - `## Archived status`
   - `## Closeout summary`
   - `## Evidence snapshot`
   - a goal-by-goal shipped-status table (13 rows; this plan is goal-based, not phase-based)
   - `## Archival gate resolution`
   - `## Historical plan`
   Then append the current full plan body verbatim under `## Historical plan`.
4. Replace `docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` with a short pointer stub modeled on the existing archived-pointer files:
   - archived notice
   - canonical completed-plan path
   - tracking issue `#3024`
   - completed/archived status
   - explicit note that the full historical plan now lives only under `docs/completed/`
5. Leave `docs/ai-tools-future-improvements.md` untouched.

Data structures affected
- Markdown-only:
  - completed-plan closeout sections
  - 13-row audit/status table
  - pointer-stub bullet list
- No code, schema, index, or runtime data changes.

API / interface changes
- No runtime/API changes.
- Documentation interface only: the stable `docs/plans/...` link remains, but the canonical full plan source moves to `docs/completed/...`.

Risks / edge cases
- The docs-only scope means any real missing prompt/guidance implementation is a hard blocker, not something to fix in this rollout.
- Avoid leaving two full copies of the plan body in both directories.
- Include tracking issue `#3024` in the archive summary because it is present in the orchestrator metadata.
- Do not silently de-scope any missing goal in the archive summary.

Testing / verification
- First verify the 13-goal audit before editing.
- If archiving proceeds, verify the diff touches only the two plan-path files.
- Verify `docs/completed/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` contains the closeout header sections plus the preserved full historical plan.
- Verify `docs/plans/apply-ai-tools-learnings-plan.md` is pointer-only and no longer duplicates the historical plan body.
- If a PR is opened, the existing plan-archival lint will provide the final guardrail for tracking-issue completeness; do not use archival prose to hide genuinely missing goals.
